answer: Pearl sybil-tax blocks fakes: each identity pays tax for a pearl receipt, key-bound on a public ledge. Each epoch the agent sends a key-signed signal presenting its pearl; auditors match it to the ledge entry. Tax is progressive per payer: first pearl 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented pearls fail: one pearl, two signals, or two keys sharing one pearl, burn both. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep their pearl.
